tasks.description: Backend adjustments for the React frontend: add CORS middleware for the Vite dev server, and verify /api/status returns the uploaded-PDF list in a shape the frontend can consume (adjust only if needed)
Scaffold the frontend/ project: React 18 + Vite, base two-pane layout shell (left sidebar + right chat area), unit test setup under frontend/tests/unit and e2e test setup under frontend/tests/e2e
Documents API client: plain-fetch wrappers for POST /api/upload (multipart PDF upload) and GET /api/status (uploaded-PDF list), with error handling, plus unit tests

Documents view: left sidebar renders the uploaded-PDF list from /api/status; chat input area has a PDF attachment button that uploads via /api/upload and refreshes the sidebar; handle upload-in-progress and upload-failure states, plus unit tests

Chat Q&A (full slice): api-client for POST /api/ask, GET/DELETE /api/history; chat window renders conversation history, question input sends /api/ask and displays the answer, thinking-in-progress state, ask-failure message, no-document-loaded state, clear-history action; plus unit tests

E2E tests in frontend/tests/e2e covering the main flow: attach and upload a PDF from the chat input, sidebar shows the file, ask a question, answer appears in the chat window, clear history resets the conversation
